evidence.finding: Ingestion ML risk score flagged moderate anomaly (0.52)

rationale: Case HHG‑020 involves a single card‑not‑present transaction (ID 3509359) on card C12265‑K2 for $125.08, flagged by the ingestion ML model with a risk score of 0.52 and a moderate anomaly weight of 0.45. The transaction matches policy R9 (CNP fraud) because it lacks a physical card link, shows a moderate anomaly, and falls within the observed fraud scale ($1‑$500), warranting escalation to an analyst given the 37 % fraud probability and high uncertainty. Uncertainty remains due to missing device fingerprinting and velocity data, and the case is only 55 % similar to a cleared transaction (CASE‑8104) while 75 % similar to a confirmed fraud (CASE‑6841), so human review is required to resolve the conflict.
